RYA-931 telluric-corrected sibling of solar_harps; solar_harps itself is UNMODIFIED. Built by correcting each of the ten Phase-3 direct-Sun exposures (1102.D-0954(A), 2023-08-02) with ESO Molecfit 4.4.4 against the observation-night La Silla NOAA GDAS column, then re-stacking and renormalising through pipeline.spectra_normalize -- the same functions that built solar_harps. LINEAGE IS PROVEN, NOT ASSUMED: re-running that path on the ten ORIGINALS reproduces the committed solar_normalized.csv byte for byte (sha256 6100681d530ffe59...), so the two holdings differ by the correction and nothing else. O2 B 6867-6884 A is the only registered telluric band inside HARPS range: min normalised flux 0.0060 -> 0.7725, pct_below_0.5 22.06 -> 0.00, and RMS against the independent Baker+2020 telluric-free IAG atlas 0.4021 -> 0.0351. The fit is refereed by physics, not by a target: O2 is well mixed, and all ten exposures return a fitted column of 1.0003-1.0018 x the reference with a mutually consistent LSF (6.7683 +/- 0.0059 px, R = 101710). 256 saturated-core pixels are QUARANTINED as NaN rather than divided, per the RYA-927 ratified policy; T_min is derived per exposure from the measured transmission accuracy. telluric_applied is DERIVED by pipeline.telluric_intake from the product's own non-unity MTRANS extension, not asserted here. CAVEAT: this is a product-level conditioning fact, NOT a line-level science verdict -- every candidate line in 6857-6911 A still needs a local telluric disposition. Evidence: data/audit/rya931_molecfit_runtime/; reproduce with scripts/rya931_correct_exposures.py then scripts/rya931_normalize_corrected.py.

RYA-940 telluric-corrected sibling of solar_kpno; the 1984 atlas itself is UNMODIFIED. Six registered telluric bands corrected per band with ESO molecfit 4.4.4 on Sirius. NO OBSERVATION METADATA EXISTS for this atlas -- no airmass, no date, no site -- so the RYA-380/927 observation-night-GDAS rule is unsatisfiable and the columns are fitted freely against the MIPAS std atmosphere. Ryan ratified that deviation on 2026-08-21. THE REFEREE THAT REPLACES 'O2 column must be 1.0': the airmass is unknown but must be the SAME unknown in every O2 band, and three O2 bands 1300 A apart agree at 1.303 / 1.306 / 1.352. External check against the telluric-free Kurucz 2005: O2 A RMS 0.5003 -> 0.0915 with median offset -0.2211 -> -0.0038; O2 B 0.3593 -> 0.1210; H2O 9280 0.4730 -> 0.0604. WARNING: for H2O the column is airmass x (PWV/reference PWV) and is NOT an airmass -- H2O returns 1.9-2.6 against O2's 1.30-1.35, which is water vapour, not a contradiction. 11120-11560 A is corrected but has NO EXTERNAL REFEREE (Kurucz 2005 and IAG both stop at 10000 A); it carries externally_validated=false and its only check is that its H2O column sits inside the family the other H2O bands return. H2O 7160-7340 A is NOT CORRECTED: all six starting points converged to an identical zero-width LSF, so the band cannot constrain the kernel; its fit rms (0.0209) was among the best, which is why fit quality is never the gate. Saturated cores are QUARANTINED as NaN on a per-band derived T_min, never divided. Products keep the atlas's own uneven sampling. CAVEAT: the atlas is a COMPOSITE of FTS scans, so the O2 agreement shows those segments shared conditions -- it is not proof one atmosphere describes all 251 segments. Evidence: data/audit/rya940_kp1984_telluric/; reproduce with scripts/rya940_kp1984_correct.py.

Delbouille/Liege Jungfraujoch disk-center INTENSITY atlas (mu=1.0), BASS2000 visible arm, 3000.0000-10000.0000 A, 2380014 points, no gap above 0.004 A. SHA-256 72a1d97b4201872425b37d2f15982357a37fa52647ad83b469f2bb28748ef794 on /mnt/codex-data/solar_reference/delbouille_bass2000/delbouille_bass2000_visible.csv.gz. GEOMETRY IS THE POINT: this is disk-center intensity, NOT the disk-integrated flux of solar_kpno - a different geometry AND a different instrument, so the two are not interchangeable and a synthesis against this one must run at mu=1 in intensity mode. WAVELENGTH MEDIUM IS AIR AS DELIVERED: RYA-944 specified vacuum and prescribed a vac->air conversion; that is REFUTED - 9 line centroids sit +3 to +14 mA from AIR rest and 1.1-2.4 A from vacuum, so applying the conversion would shift the atlas by about -1.8 A. No conversion is applied and none must be added. The ticket smoke test could not have caught this: argmin over a 0.004 A grid returns the nearest GRID POINT, which is within 0.002 A of any value in any medium. telluric_applied DETERMINED FROM FLUX, not assumed: measured against Kitt Peak (retains) and IAG-Baker2020 (corrected) in the same windows with a clean-continuum control where all four agree to 0.2 pp - Delbouille runs 26.32 pct below 0.5 in the O2 A-band and 12.61 in the O2 B-band, reaching 0.000, so tellurics are PRESENT and saturated there; H2O is 7-8x cleaner than Kitt Peak, the high-altitude signature, NOT a correction.
